'''Chiemi Chiba''' (Japanese: '''千葉千恵巳''' ''Chiba Chiemi'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Chiba was born on February 25, 1975, in {{wp|Kawaguchi, Saitama}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. Affiliated with the talent agency Umikaze, she led a long voice acting career since the late 1980s and became known for a number of roles in anime series. Chiba provided her voice for [[Pokémon Coordinator]] [[Erica]] in {{aniseries|RS}} of {{aniseries|PTS}}.
